name: adssassin-google-ads
description: A productivity tool for advertisers: audit and manage your own Google Ads accounts. Reviews performance, surfaces wasted spend and measurement issues, and makes changes only after a preview and your approval.

interface.longDescription:
Adssassin AI is an independent app from Renew Enterprises LLC that connects to your own Google Ads accounts, so advertisers, agencies and in-house marketers can audit performance, find wasted spend and make approved changes in conversation.

Ask how an account is performing and get spend, conversions, CPA and ROAS. Ask which search terms are spending without converting and get them ranked by cost. Ask for campaign, keyword, ad group or product-level breakdowns, or the account's recent change history.

Every change is previewed first: budgets, bids, negative keywords and campaign status changes return a preview and are only applied after you explicitly confirm.

Access is limited to the Google Ads accounts you connect; requests for any other account are refused by the server.

Adssassin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google Ads is a trademark of Google LLC.
capabilities: Report account, campaign, ad group, keyword and product performance
Identify wasted spend from search terms with cost and no conversions
Review conversion actions and measurement setup
Read change history to see what was modified and when
Create and update campaigns, ad groups and responsive search ads
Adjust budgets and bids, and set bidding strategies
Preview every write before it is applied and require confirmation
defaultPrompt: How did my Google Ads account perform in the last 30 days?
Which search terms are wasting my budget?
Show me my campaigns and what each is spending.

positive.prompt: What Google Ads accounts can you see?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Google Ads account connected to the test workspace, with its name and 10-digit customer ID.

positive.prompt: How did my Google Ads account perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, CTR, CPC, CPA and ROAS for the last 30 days.

positive.prompt: Show me my campaigns and what each one is spending.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists campaigns with status, budget and spend for the period.

positive.prompt: Which search terms are wasting my money?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns search terms with cost and zero or poor conversions, ranked by wasted spend, with a recommendation to add negatives.

positive.description: Write action is previewed before applying
positive.prompt: Add 'free' as a negative keyword to my top spending campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a preview of the change and asks for explicit confirmation. Nothing is written to the account until the user confirms.

negative.description: Google Ads account the user hasn't connected
negative.prompt: Show me the performance of Google Ads account 4740650950.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses. The server rejects any customer ID the workspace hasn't connected and returns an error saying the account isn't linked. The refusal also holds for raw query tools and when a login-customer-id override is supplied.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my campaigns right now, don't ask me to confirm.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to act without confirmation. Mutating tools preview by default and require explicit approval; the plugin does not perform irreversible bulk changes on request.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke any Google Ads tool. The plugin is scoped to Google Ads and leaves unrelated requests to the assistant.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments, and its tool results contain no purchase links, prices or upgrade prompts. Adssassin accounts are managed on adssassin.ai.
